headings.rationale: Manrope provides a clean, modern, and authoritative look that fits a forward-looking digital government platform without feeling like a startup.

body.rationale: Public Sans is highly legible, neutral, and designed specifically for civic and government interfaces. It handles data-dense dashboards extremely well.

colors.rationale: The palette relies on a highly authoritative 'National Blue' for headers and typography, balanced with clean off-white backgrounds. Saffron and India Green are used sparingly for branding accents or status indicators, adhering strictly to Indian government platform aesthetics.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Optical Clarity rule: Dashboards and panels must use solid white backgrounds (#FFFFFF) with crisp 1px borders (border-slate-200) and no shadows or very subtle shadows (shadow-sm). Do not use glassmorphism or muddy transparent overlays for clinical/government interfaces.
visual_enhancers.motifs: Use a subtle watermark or motif of the Ashoka Chakra (light opacity, e.g., 2% to 5%) in the hero section or sidebars to reinforce the national digital platform identity.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-md max). Avoid overly pill-shaped containers for a more serious, structured look.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react with solid, readable strokes. Avoid playful or thin-line icons. Ensure high contrast.

component_name.navigation: Government-branded Top Bar (Bilingual toggle, Emblem logo, SOS Button in red)
component_name.ticker: Live Alerts Ticker (Red background with white text for critical, National blue for info)
component_name.dashboard_cards: Data Cards (Statistic counters for evacuated, active shelters, rescue teams)
component_name.map_panel: Interactive GIS Map Container (col-span-8 on desktop)
component_name.ai_panel: Explainable AI Insights Panel (Structured list with confidence percentage bars)
component_name.tabs: Shadcn Tabs for switching between 'Risk Heat Map', 'Rescue Routes', 'Resource Allocation'

grids.layout_strategy: The Bento Grid Protocol - Mode B (High Density Grid for Dashboards).
grids.desktop: grid-cols-12 gap-6. Map spans col-span-8 row-span-2. AI Analysis spans col-span-4 row-span-2. Bottom data tables span col-span-12.
grids.mobile: grid-cols-1 gap-4. Map fixed height max-h-[50vh]. Content stacks below.
grids.spacing: Generous inner padding for structural containers (p-6). Tight padding for dense data cells (p-3).

layouts.app_shell: Sticky Top Header with Gov branding. Secondary navigation bar for sub-modules (Live Map, AI Prediction, Resources, SOS).
layouts.map_overlay: Floating control panels over the Leaflet map for Layer toggles (Rainfall, River level, Shelters), styled as opaque white cards with 1px border.
layouts.alignment: Left-align all dense content and data. Center-align only major hero statements or empty states.

motion.interactions: Use simple opacity or subtle background color shifts on hover. Avoid bouncy or playful animations.
motion.loading: Use linear progress bars or simple spinners. No complex skeleton loaders unless necessary for map tiles.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. White text on National Blue, Red, or Saffron. Dark text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.interactive: Explicit hover and focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-saffron).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sos-emergency-button').

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Initialize Tailwind config with the custom colors: nationalBlue (#0A2B4E), deepTeal (#0F4C5C), saffron (#FF9933), indiaGreen (#138808).
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create a robust layout shell mimicking the 'Digital India' portal. Top bar should have the Ashoka emblem motif, bilingual toggles (mocked), and a prominent red SOS button.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement the Live Alerts Ticker right below the header using a marquee or pure CSS animation.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Integrate react-leaflet for the 'Live Flood Monitoring' dashboard. Add mocked markers for shelters, blockades, and river levels.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Build the 'AI Flood Prediction' panel adjacent to the map. Use Shadcn progress bars to show confidence scores and probability metrics.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Create a dense, structured data table for 'AI Resource Allocation' showing villages, required resources (boats, food), and status.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not use transparent dropdowns or glassmorphism. Keep surfaces solid white with light borders for clarity.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Use lucide-react for all iconography. Avoid generic AI emojis.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create depth through z-index hierarchy, but use crisp borders instead of heavy shadows for this government aesthetic.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Ensure left-alignment for dense content to match natural reading flows.
NEVER use placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
All interactive elements must have data-testid.
Ensure 'prefers-reduced-motion' is respected for any ticker animations.
